conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately? Please describe what happens, where it occurs, and any specific consequences.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I’m just floundering at work. I can’t seem to move forward on a pretty simple project, and I’m having a hard time concentrating. It’s like I can’t really picture where things are going from here.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment? Please share anything you would like help with.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’d like to function at work again, and just be able to move forward.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental health professional?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: By “assessed,” I mean having a mental health professional—such as a psychiatrist, psychologist, therapist, or social worker—ask about your mental health to understand your concerns or provide an evaluation. Has this ever happened?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, not that I remember.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received a psychiatric diagnosis, such as depression, anxiety, OCD, or bipolar disorder?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes — depression, back in college, and it’s come up more than once.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further psychiatric diagnoses you’re aware of?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health reasons?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever thought about or tried to intentionally hurt yourself?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No.

conversation.message: Have you ever received any therapy, such as CBT, DBT, Interpersonal Therapy, Mindfulness-Based Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, or another type?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I took some time off after my dad died. I don’t know if that’s what you mean, but that’s the only thing I can think of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Taking time off after your father died does not necessarily mean therapy. Did you meet with a mental health professional for counselling or therapy during that time?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m not sure I’m following — do you mean someone I was actually meeting with regularly, like for counselling? I did take time off around then, but I’m not sure what category that falls into.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, I mean meeting with a mental health professional for counselling or therapy, either regularly or for a limited number of sessions. Did you have any such meetings?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I didn’t have that.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received rTMS, ECT, deep brain stimulation, ketamine treatment, or another biological treatment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, none of that.

conversation.message: Are you currently taking any prescribed medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
